rules.name: Minimum Necessary Standard
rules.message: Disclosure exceeds minimum necessary requirement and does not fall under direct clinical treatment exception.

rules.name: Business Associate Agreement Requirement
rules.message: Disclosure of PHI to a Business Associate without an executed BAA is a regulatory violation.

rules.name: Treatment, Payment, Operations Carve-out
rules.message: Disclosure is permitted under §164.506 TPO exception without explicit authorization.
